findingDetails.title: The regrade log's outcome vocabulary is never defined, and `wrong` covers both a false fact and a true fact with a false implication
findingDetails.scopeProof: The outcome list is at regrade-log.md:3; the two wrong rows are :29 and :338; the grade definitions are research.md:18-20; the plan lines that make :29 right are B/001-activity-and-actor/spec.md:153 and tasks.md:80, both read directly.
affectedSurfaceHints: research/regrade-log.md intro and every wrong row
findingDetails.case: An auditor picks regrade-log.md:29, runs ls on THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, gets No such file or directory, and records the rejection as wrong, because nothing says wrong judges the conclusion rather than the fact.
findingDetails.claim: The six outcomes are listed but never defined, and wrong is applied both to a false fact and to a true fact whose implication is false.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Searched the log intro, section 1 and section 8 for a definition of wrong; section 1 defines only confirmed and weak, and section 8 uses wrong without defining it.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The reason column defines wrong case by case, so the label never has to stand alone.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: A sentence in the log intro or section 1 that says wrong judges the finding conclusion rather than its stated fact.
